texts390.text: A starting point for Grok Bot. Choose a goal. Get a playbook.
What do you want Grok Bot to do for you?
Follow the attention. Look closer at the risks.
Find your next post. Keep your own voice.
Spot the opening. Start a better conversation.
A morning summary of funding rates, open interest and liquidations.
Research new token launches, public facts and red flags.
Review stock news, earnings and token price differences.
Track upcoming unlocks and research airdrop requirements and risks.
Separate verified project facts from claims, rumors and open questions.
Draft two X threads in your niche and voice for your review.
You set the goal. You stay in control.
No account needed here. Take your playbook to Grok Bot when you’re ready.
Research and instructions only. nuntio never trades, connects a wallet or signs anything.
